scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.bundle: spago bundle -p chat && spago bundle -p counter && spago bundle -p ui
scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run bundle && bun run config && wrangler dev --config apps/site/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: bun run check && bun run build && bun run bundle && bun run config && wrangler deploy --config apps/site/wrangler.jsonc
